title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
material_use: Supports context-aware validity reliability monitoring human roles and risk-proportionate controls.
material_limitations: Voluntary and use-case agnostic; not a self-storage standard threshold certification or deployment claim.

title: NIST Special Publication 800-61 Revision 3: Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations for Cybersecurity Risk Management
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
provenance: Primary U.S. government publication page; April 2025 final superseding Revision 2
material_use: Supports the distinction among observable events potentially adverse events and incidents plus analysis and correlation across sources.
material_limitations: Cybersecurity guidance; does not define a self-storage operating incident or authorize facility action.

title: OpenTelemetry Logs Data Model
provenance: Primary technical specification maintained by the OpenTelemetry project
material_use: Supports separate event and observation timestamps plus resource trace and span context.
material_limitations: Telemetry structure and correlation context do not prove a shared physical cause or business incident.

title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
material_use: Supports distinguishable entities activities agents derivation attribution and invalidation in provenance records.
material_limitations: Domain-agnostic provenance model; does not define self-storage authority or incident formation.
